title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Mandi L. Matlock is a Lecturer on Law at Harvard Law School, where she teaches the Federal Tax Seminar. She also serves as Interim Director of the Federal Tax Clinic at the Legal Services Center of Harvard Law School, where she trains and supervises students in federal tax litigation and administrative practice.
